meta.summary: Sourced + verified license-clean media for the 'space race / new contenders' story: one BGM track, one oEmbed video, and 17 real photos (15 cover-able landscape backgrounds for the cinematic). Every asset carries a checked license + identity block.
meta.bgm_note: BGM is mandatory; chose a genuinely license-clean (CC BY 3.0, non-review-pending) restrained ambient track over the better-theme but review-pending 'space ambient' option. 45 MB FLAC — Designer must transcode.
meta.video_note: One oEmbed-verified YouTube embed (SpaceX Falcon Heavy, the Feb 2018 headline moment). The live-stream alternative xLIb8glag-0 was rejected (oEmbed HTTP 403 = embedding disabled).
meta.live_status_note: No live_status: this is a closed 2018 historical dataset, not an ongoing event. Adding forward-dated launch tallies would muddy the dataset's 2018 snapshot (see detective det_11 truncation caveat). Skipped by design.
gaps_for_designer: No license-clean REAL Jiuquan/Xichang or Cape Canaveral *site* wide-shot was kept (the launch photos themselves carry the China and US sites); a dedicated site/skyline or a launch-provider world map can be generated/data-driven if wanted.

Rocket Lab Electron real launch photos on Commons are 2023-2024 (the only license-clean ones); captioned generically as 'Rocket Lab Electron', not date-specific. A 2018 Electron photo could not be sourced license-clean.

Dropped 4 candidates that failed identity/quality: change5_launch (distant glow, weak ID), ariane5_pad (tourists were the real subject), kourou (campus+rainbow, caption-mismatch), electron diagram .webp (a render, not a photo).

sct_01.caption: License-clean ambient instrumental sourced for the top-of-article spinning-vinyl soundtrack.
caption_claims: this is a license-clean ambient music track

identity.verified_title: Commons file page asserts CC BY 3.0 (plain {{cc-by-3.0}}, NOT a review-pending YouTube import); artist raspberrymusic (raspberrysounds, royalty-free ambient).
identity.subject: ambient instrumental track (~10 min)

sct_01.note: Lead is a sober, analytical Cold-War-to-now space history, so the mood word was 'ambient'/'restrained cinematic', not a celebratory anthem. FILE IS A 45 MB 10-min FLAC — Designer MUST transcode to a web-weight streaming copy (~128 kbps mp3/opus, <3 MB) before referencing; the heavy original never ships. No Commons cover art existed, so cover_path reuses the PD Earth-from-orbit still scout_earth_limb.jpg (square-croppable for the spinning disc). Alternatives if a different tone is wanted: 'Dreamstate Logic – Zero Point (space ambient)' (File on Commons, CC-BY-3.0 but pending Commons license review — stronger THEME fit, swap only after the review clears) or 'Chopin Nocturne No. 21, B.108' performed by Diana Hughes / Musopen (genuinely PD recording — guaranteed-clean classical floor).
